relationships.paper: CausalVLBench: Benchmarking Visual Causal Reasoning in Large Vision-Language Models
relationships.evidence: We construct a benchmark, CausalVLBench, encompassing three representative tasks: causal structure inference, intervention target prediction, and counterfactual prediction to evaluate the visual causal reasoning capabilities of LVLMs under zero and few shot settings. (Section 1)
